claims.evidence: Structural integrity and frame strength cannot be determined without a physical stress test or detailed inspection for cracks.
The witness report identifies the colors and components but does not specify the condition of the paint or the level of wear.
The witness confirmed the item is a bicycle with features (carrier, fenders) consistent with a child's utility bike.

risks.risk: Braking system may be defective or unresponsive.
risks.proof: A video clip showing the hand brakes being squeezed and successfully stopping the wheels while they are spinning.
risks.if_unproven: as having non-functional brakes requiring replacement.

risks.risk: Tires and tubes may be perished, punctured, or bald.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of tire treads and a video showing the tires holding air under pressure.
risks.if_unproven: as needing a full set of new tires and tubes.

risks.risk: Drivetrain (chain and pedals) may be seized or heavily rusted.
risks.proof: A video showing the pedals being turned by hand to demonstrate the chain moving freely.
risks.if_unproven: as requiring a new chain and bottom bracket service.

proof_requests: Video of the bicycle being pedaled and the brakes being applied.
Close-up photos of the frame joints and under the fenders to check for rust.
Clear photos of the tire tread condition.
response.reason: The item is confirmed to be a bicycle. It can be priced at the baseline for a used unit, assuming the worst-case scenario for all mechanical and consumable parts.
